proposal.description: The disagreement counter only counts an assert attempt (flag_in high while flag_out is low), so the release direction never builds a count
proposal.reason: With the default fail-safe RESET_VALUE of 1, flag_out comes out of reset high and a healthy (low) flag_in never builds a count, so flag_out stays asserted forever and the supervisor never sees the fault clear.

after: else if ((flag_in != RESET_VALUE) && (flag_in != flag_out) && (disagree_counter >= target_clks - 1'b1)) begin
proposal.description: flag_out is only allowed to flip when flag_in moves away from the fail-safe RESET_VALUE, so a return to the reset level (a re-asserted fault, with the default RESET_VALUE of 1) never updates flag_out
proposal.reason: After the first qualified release, flag_out is low. A real fault that holds flag_in high for ASSERT_CLKS clocks or more lets the counter reach its target and restart, but flag_out never asserts again.

proposal.description: The clear-on-qualify restart only happens when an assert qualifies. On the edge a release qualifies, the disagreement count is left at RELEASE_CLKS-1
proposal.reason: If flag_in goes back high on the clock straight after a release flips flag_out low, the assert window starts from RELEASE_CLKS-1 instead of zero. flag_out then re-asserts after about ASSERT_CLKS-RELEASE_CLKS clocks instead of the full ASSERT_CLKS.
